How to use

HTML slides — the main version: interactive widgets, Python/MATLAB code tabs with copy buttons. Press F for full screen, S for speaker view, Esc for the slide overview.
PDF (slides) — one slide per page, for tablets (GoodNotes, Notability, …).
PDF (handout) — A4, three slides per page with ruled note space, for printing.
Notebook — opens in Google Colab; run all cells to reproduce the figures.
